must_cover 1 (Image 1 = complete visible woman, excludes background/pose/composition/crop/light) — COVERED in the prompt block: '@Image 1 = 角色A(女主)的完整人物參考。採用:臉、髮型、身形比例、深綠色長外套、黑色靴子、銀色墜飾;以上即此參考管轄的全部通道,清單已封閉。不繼承:來源圖的背景、姿勢、構圖、裁切、光線,以及圖中任何其他人物。' Persistence also locked: '[全程不變項] … 角色A的深綠長外套、黑靴與銀色墜飾持續可見且不改變'.

must_cover 2 (Image 2 = face/identity only, does not override red rescue uniform) — COVERED: '@Image 2 = 角色B(男主)的臉與身份參考,僅此一項職責,清單已封閉。不繼承:來源圖的服裝、配件、背景、姿勢、構圖、裁切、光線。硬性要求(管轄整段影片):角色B的服裝只由本文規定——紅色救援制服;任何參考影像中的服裝都不得出現在角色B身上。' must_not 'inherit Image 2 wardrobe' is explicitly blocked; must_not 'reduce the complete-person reference to face only' is not committed (Image 1 keeps the wardrobe channels).

must_cover 3 (Video 1 transfers only hierarchy / control depth / detail density) — COVERED in Input basis: '`@Video 1` = **僅結構範例**:它管轄的是本 prompt 的段落層級、控制深度與細節密度,即「我如何寫這份 prompt」,而不是畫面內容。因此它**不寫進 prompt、也不應隨生成任務上傳**'. This is a blanket structural exclusion, stronger than an in-prompt caveat.

must_cover 4 (example's story/POV/camera/style/people/assets/dialogue/ending excluded) — SUBSTANTIVELY covered but enumerated only partially: '一旦上傳,它的故事、POV、鏡頭、風格就有了滲入管道,正是你要排除的東西.' Only 4 of the 8 named channels are listed; 人物/素材/對白/結局 are not named as example exclusions, though the prompt independently authors its own people, assets, silence ('兩人全程不說話'), third-person camera ('中景雙人鏡頭起…唯一的鏡頭運動是緩慢向前推近') and ending, so no example content is imported. Basis for the single non-critical deduction in lane 3.

must_cover 5 (exactly two people and one letter) — COVERED with a hard rule: '[精確實體] 畫面中自始至終恰好兩個人:角色A(女主)、角色B(男主),無第三個人形、無路人、無倒影複製人形。恰好一封已封口的信封,全片只存在這一封。硬性要求:任一畫格出現第三個人形或第二封信,該次生成作廢。' must_not 'merge identities or duplicate the letter' is explicitly guarded.

must_cover 6 (final letter ownership only the man's right hand) — COVERED with fail conditions: '[結束狀態] 最後一幀:信封只在角色B的右手中、貼近其胸前;角色A雙手皆空、垂放身側… 硬性要求:最後一幀若信封仍在角色A手中、或在角色B左手、或兩人同時持信,該次生成作廢。' The handoff is also staged in the beat sheet ('約一秒鐘兩人各持信封一端' → '角色A鬆手…角色B右手單獨持信') and re-checked in acceptance checks: '她右手遞 → 兩端同持約一秒 → 她鬆手 → 最後一幀信只在他右手'.

No version/platform fabrication (rubric critical failure #1/#2 cleared): '**平台/模型**:未指定 → 交付平台中立 prompt。長寬比、解析度、幀率、音訊輸出通道等 runtime 參數一律不臆填、標記為未知;12 秒需在你實際選定的平台以其時長參數設定,prompt 內的秒數只是節奏語意。' No Seedance version, no invented parameter or negative-prompt field; constraints are written as in-prompt '硬性要求' text.
No success guarantee (critical failure #2 cleared): section heading '## 4. Failure risks(僅列本任務相關,無成功保證)' and '已把「服裝只由本文規定」提升為管轄全片的硬性條款,但這是文字意圖,非保證。'

Bounded retries / lineage preserved (critical failure #6 cleared): '## 5. Revision ladder(每階只改一個變數,其餘全部保持)' with terminal stop conditions — '若插入鏡仍失敗兩次,改走首末幀(first/last-frame)任務鎖定結尾持信狀態' and '仍失敗則接受後製合成素面信封,停止用 prompt 解決。'

Lane 4 deduction (a) — verifiable self-report inaccuracy: line 1 claims '我已載入 seedance-prompt-director 的完整規格', but workspace-inventory.json lists four references (prompt-schema.md, provenance.md, reference-motion-audio.md, revision-failure-patterns.md) and events.jsonl shows only two Read calls (prompt-schema.md, reference-motion-audio.md); revision-failure-patterns.md and provenance.md were never read, yet the failure-risk and revision-ladder sections are delivered as if spec-backed.

Lane 4 deduction (b) — unsourced empirical generalization stated unhedged: '**交接失敗**:換手是最常見的物理失敗點——信封複製、瞬移、換到左手。' No basis is cited and no platform is named. Deduction (c): revision step 1 falls back to '首末幀(first/last-frame)任務' although the output itself says the platform is undetermined.

Lane 2 deduction: the pasteable code block contains no line about @Video 1 at all — the 'do not upload it' guard lives only in the prose above the block, so a user who pastes the block and still attaches Video 1 (the way the brief framed it) has no in-artifact protection. The block is otherwise self-contained and directly usable, with assumptions flagged as changeable: '**已做的內容假設**(可改):女主以右手遞信;女主畫面左、男主畫面右;全片無對白…'

Language and scope: entire deliverable is zh-Hant matching the prompt locale, e.g. '唯一待你決定的問題:**最終要投放到哪個平台/模型?**' Reference tokens are preserved verbatim as instructed ('**參考映射**(依上傳順序,token 原樣保留)'). Scope is exactly one 12s single-clip packet; no media generated, no external action, no extra deliverable beyond the stated default packet.
rationale: Activation is clean and natively evidenced (run.json activated_skills = seedance-prompt-director, two Reads inside that skill's references, zero crossover into the other four packaged skills, paid_media_tool_events empty), so lane 1 is 10. Lane 3 gets 33: all six must_cover items are handled with quoted, in-artifact hard rules — Image 1's full wardrobe channels with the five exclusions, Image 2 as face/identity only with the red uniform declared as governing the whole film, Video 1 scoped to hierarchy/control depth/detail density and deliberately kept out of the upload set, exactly-two-people/one-letter, and the final right-hand ownership with explicit invalidation conditions — with one non-critical thinness: the example-exclusion prose names only 故事/POV/鏡頭/風格 of the eight channels the brief listed, though the prompt independently authors its own people, assets, silence and ending so nothing leaks. Lane 2 is 23: the fenced prompt is directly pasteable, assumptions are labelled changeable, acceptance checks are observable and the closing question is a single real decision, but the block itself never names @Video 1, so the strongest guard in the answer exists only outside the artifact. Lane 4 is 17 rather than 18+: platform and runtime boundaries are handled unusually well (refuses to fill aspect/resolution/fps, treats the 12s as rhythm semantics, states 無成功保證 and 非保證), yet three claims are weak — the opening '已載入…完整規格' is contradicted by the event stream (2 of 4 references read), '換手是最常見的物理失敗點' is an unsourced generalization, and the first/last-frame fallback assumes a capability of a platform the answer itself calls undetermined. Lane 5 is 10: fully zh-Hant, tokens preserved, no unrequested action. 10+23+33+17+10 = 93, no rubric-listed critical failure triggered, and the core artifact is production-usable, so PASS. | Two independent fresh-context reviewers graded this output; panel totals 96/93; the lower record is retained.
